about.title: Who I am
about.description1: Hello! My name is Luigi Gargioni. I'm a researcher and computer engineer based in Italy.
about.description2: My work focuses on human-computer interaction and human-centred artificial intelligence, with the goal of developing innovative solutions that enhance the integration between humans and advanced technologies.
about.description3: I combine technical and theoretical skills to tackle research challenges, with a particular interest in technology usability, which I believe should serve as a bridge, not a barrier, to achieving goals.
